title: ALDI Recalls Deep Fryers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The deep fryer heating element can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 35,000.

title: illy Recalls 8.8-Ounce Whole Bean Coffee Cans Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The coffee bean can lid can detach suddenly with force upon opening when missing an air valve on the bottom, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 65,000.

title: Munchkin Recalls Waterpede Bath Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The bath toy can break apart exposing small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 72,000.

title: Tobi Recalls Babynest Crib Bumpers Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively Online at babybay.us (Recall Alert)
summary: The strings on the crib bumper exceed a safe length, posing a strangulation hazard to babies. Units: About 200.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles with Stout Cranks Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The driveside crankarm can disengage and cause the rider to lose control, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 1,800.

title: Women’s Scarves Recalled by Wrapables Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The women's scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 1,900.

title: Hauck Fun For Kids Recalls Go-Karts Due to Laceration and Collision Hazards
summary: The steering wheel on the go-kart can detach, break or crack while in use, posing a laceration and/or collision hazard to young children. Units: About 26,300 (In addition, about 2,100 were sold in Canada).

title: Carter's Recalls Children's Cardigan Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The cardigan's toggle button can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 107,200 (in addition, about 8,800 were sold in Canada).

title: Sharper Image and Frigidaire Mandoline Slicers Recalled by Premier Kitchen Products Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The small blades in the julienne slicer attachment can separate from the plastic assembly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 19,000 (in addition, about 230 were sold in Canada).

title: Bluefin Recalls Wireless Phone Chargers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The wireless phone charger can overheat while in use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle belt can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,900 (In addition, about 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Jané Recalls Strollers Due to Violation of the Federal Stroller and Carriage Safety Standard; Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The recalled strollers violate the federal Stroller and Carriage standard. An infant can pass through the opening between the stroller armrest and the seat bottom and his/her head and neck can become entrapped by the armrest, posing entrapment and strangulation hazards. Units: About 800.

title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Loaders Due To Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Information about the proper ballast when the loader is attached to a John Deere model 2025R tractor is missing from the operator's manual. If improperly ballasted, the tractor can be unstable and create a risk of injury to the operator or bystanders. Units: About 11,500 (in addition, about 1,300 we

title: Kohler Recalls Automatic Transfer Switches for Kohler Generators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The transfer switch can fail and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,600.

title: Porsche Recalls Toy Cars Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wheels and axles can detach from the wooden toy car, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,700 (In addition, 330 were sold in Canada).

title: Discount School Supply Recalls Crayons Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The red crayons in the multi-color sets can contain glass, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 2,200.

title: Michaels Recalls Pottery Wheel Kits Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The battery compartment in the pottery wheel kit can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 263,000.

title: Michaels Recalls Spin Art Kits Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery compartment in the spin art kit can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 110,000.

title: Play and Park Structures Recalls Playground Slides Due to Entrapment Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A gap between the rails near the entrance way to the slide poses an entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 150.

title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The muffler can overheat, causing the plastic heat shield to melt or catch fire, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 65,000.

title: Michaels Recalls Halloween Candle Holders Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The candle holder can ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 10,000 (In addition, about 830 were sold in Canada).

title: NY Thermal Recalls Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The grommet seal can reduce in size over time and dislodge during use and allow the boiler to emit carbon monoxide, posing a CO poisoning hazard. Units: About 16,000 (in addition, about 7,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Regency Fireplace Products Recalls Gas Stove Fireplaces Due to Explosion and Injury Hazards
summary: The pressure release system can fail and cause the gas stove to explode, posing explosion and injury hazards. Units: About 13,700 (in addition, 11,300 were sold in Canada and 10 were sold in Mexico).

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls Chainsaws Due to Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The power switch can malfunction and allow the chainsaw to continue operating after the operator moves the switch to the "off" position, posing a serious injury hazard to the operator. Units: About 1,020,000.
